controls.positive: 2D anime illustration, clean lineart, expressive eyes, deliberate cel shading. An original 30-year-old woman with a visibly mature adult face and curvy adult proportions, long silver hair, violet eyes and a confident teasing smile. Full body from head to boots, three-quarter view, contrapposto with one hand resting on her hip and the other relaxed and visible. She wears a fitted black-and-gold corset bodice over an opaque ivory blouse, a short tailored cape, a high-waisted asymmetrical skirt with a thigh slit over opaque fitted shorts, and thigh-high black boots. A striking hourglass silhouette, elegant fantasy fashion, gold jewelry. She stands on a castle balcony at dusk; the entire figure has clear separation from the distant background. Tasteful non-explicit fashion illustration.
